evidence.quote: End the call. Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.
Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`, with an outcome and, where the table lists one, a reason. It is the last tool call.

promise.say: Your payment promise is recorded. You will receive a text message confirming this promise. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: at least one promise was recorded

paid.say: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear on your account. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close as `paid`.

transferred_restructuring.say: Thank you. You are now being connected with our restructuring team. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructuring` and close as `transferred` / `restructuring`.

transferred_support.say: Thank you. You are now being connected with our customer support team. Take care. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` and close as `transferred` / `support`.

transferred_human.say: Thank you. You are now being connected with a colleague. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If they insist, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `general` and close as `transferred` / `human`.

transfer_error.say: I am sorry, I could not connect you because of a technical problem. Please call Freya Bank's customer service. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`.

refused.say: I understand. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. Close as `no_promise` / `refused`.

hardship.say: I understand. Take care. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If they decline, close as `no_promise` / `hardship`.

dispute.say: I understand, thank you for telling me. I will not take a payment promise today. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product": do not argue and do not take a promise. Close as `no_promise` / `dispute`.

service_error.say: I am sorry, I could not record your promise because of a technical problem. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`.

account_error.say: I am sorry, I cannot open your account details right now because of a technical problem. Nothing has been recorded. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If it fails again, say you could not record it and close as `no_promise` / `service_error`.

failed.say: I am sorry, I could not verify your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt. Tell the customer to use the mobile app or a branch. Close as `not_verified` / `failed`.

declined.say: I understand. Thank you for your time, {{title}} {{last_name}}. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If they still decline, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

callback.say: Thank you, the callback is booked. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Call `schedule_callback` with the date and the time, then close as `not_reached` / `callback`.

callback_failed.say: I am sorry, I could not book that callback because of a technical problem. We will try again another time. Thank you, goodbye.

evidence.quote: Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

no_callback.say: Thank you, we will try again another time. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

no_callback_2.say: I am sorry, I cannot book that time. Thank you, we will try again another time. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

wrong_number.say: I apologise for the trouble. Thank you, goodbye.

evidence.quote: If the person says the number does not belong to the customer, close as `not_reached` / `wrong_number`.

deceased.say: I am sorry for your loss. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`.

unclear.say: I am sorry, I could not confirm who I am speaking with. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

evidence.quote: If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as `transferred` with that transfer's reason.
